definition: a group of people who play music together
description: A sunlit colonial town square. A woman in a denim jacket films herself smiling and clapping while behind her a group of musicians in matching pale blue shirts play guitars and a tuba beside a stone fountain. A young waiter in a bow tie and apron carries a tray of glasses out of an archway and waves at the camera. The shot pulls back higher and higher: families, a policeman and small children gather in a ring around the players, and the whole plaza with its church tower and yellow and red buildings comes into view under a bright blue sky.

taps.phrase: to balance a tray of drinks
